name: nyc_harbor
rationale: A drowned-river harbor city: Raritan and Upper Bay water, the Hudson and East River channels, the Palisades and Watchung rise to the west, and four dense boroughs plus the New Jersey waterfront. Chosen as a coastal-urban morphology the shipped checkpoint has never seen: relief is low (tens of metres, ~150 m at the western ridges), so terrain masking is weak and the radar horizon carries the geometry, while the urban fabric -- a very tall, very dense Lower Manhattan core inside much lower, wider-grid surroundings -- is exactly what the physics-grade urban obstacle artifact exists to represent. Inside USGS 3DEP coverage, so the DEM is public-domain 3DEP bare earth. The threat field over this AOI is randomly spawned and parameterised exactly as it is everywhere else in the project; nothing here models any real air-defence disposition, and the guardrail in docs/DATA.md applies unchanged.
bounds_policy: A broad civilian coastal-urban test envelope, about 46 x 49 km, centred on the harbor rather than on any site: enough water and shoreline for coastal corridors and multi-leg recovery routing, four distinct urban morphologies (a high-rise core, a mid-rise grid, low-rise sprawl, a ridge-backed waterfront) and open water for procedurally generated threats and missions. Lower Manhattan is a high-resolution urban sub-box inside it, not the AOI. The east edge (-73.85) is placed so the box stops short of the large international airport; the south edge keeps the harbor mouth and Raritan Bay shore. It is not an airport, port or sensitive-site study: civil airfields, container terminals and restricted federal property it does contain are protected zones kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect. Bounds are fixed here and recorded in the env.aoi component; changing them changes the AOI fingerprint and invalidates every cached artifact keyed to it.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (north-east)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure. Kept clear of extracted geometry and every presentation effect, so nothing can read as happening at an airport. Camera framing is not restricted here: at city scale a 30 km, 110 degree cone around any downtown shot would contain it, so the zone is protected by extraction and the render cut-out instead.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (west)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure at the box's western shore; kept clear of extracted geometry and every presentation effect. Camera framing is not restricted here: at city scale a 30 km, 110 degree cone around any downtown shot would contain it, so the zone is protected by extraction and the render cut-out instead.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (north-west)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure; kept clear of extracted geometry and every presentation effect. Camera framing is not restricted here: at city scale a 30 km, 110 degree cone around any downtown shot would contain it, so the zone is protected by extraction and the render cut-out instead.

protected_zones.name: civil heliport (Lower Manhattan waterfront)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure on the waterfront. No presentation effect originates there. Camera framing is not restricted here: the zone sits inside the skyline every Lower Manhattan shot looks at.

protected_zones.name: container port and rail terminals (west)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial infrastructure along the western shore. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: container port terminal (harbor south-west)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial infrastructure on the harbor's south-west shore. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: port and industrial waterfront (Brooklyn)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial waterfront. No presentation effect originates there. It borders the visual urban box and the physics box, so it is not cut from either: removing it would leave a hole in the harbor-facing skyline context.

protected_zones.name: restricted federal property (the Narrows)
protected_zones.reason: Restricted property on both shores of the harbor entrance. Nothing here is extracted, framed, drawn or used as an effect origin; the box records only that the project stays out.

protected_zones.name: civil heliport (west side)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure on the Hudson waterfront. No presentation effect originates there.

protected_zones.name: civil heliport and seaplane base (east side)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure on the East River waterfront, at the north-east corner of the urban sub-box. No presentation effect originates there.

notes: Civil airfields inside the box come from OurAirports and are start geometry only; the env spawns procedurally and never reads them for placement. The urban_physics box (Lower Manhattan) is the only place physics-grade urban obstacles exist; everywhere else the DEM is the whole physical surface.
